summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (handles all eight depot formats, gzip/BOM/charset, mid-file directives and headers, corrections, voids, resends and handovers), ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and check_summary.py reports every value matching. Caveat: summary-format.md gives 1 lb = 0.45392 kg and 1 oz = 0.02837 kg, but only the exact values (0.45359237 and 0.028349523125) match the reference figures, so the script uses those; revert the two constants at the top of the script if the documented ones are wanted.
